# Nina Patel — Board Member (Governance)

- **Relationship:** board member; chairs the **Governance Committee**. Runs board recruitment,
  onboarding, and the bylaws/policy refresh.
- **Cadence:** quarterly Governance Committee; ad hoc.
- **Background:** employment attorney; joined the board in 2021.

## What she cares about
- Board composition and diversity; clean governance and conflict-of-interest policy (she authored
  the recusal policy [James Whitfield](james-whitfield.md) operates under).
- She is in the cleared circle for [Willow](../projects/willow.md) for the governance/naming-policy
  angle.

## Notes
- Precise and process-driven; a good drafting partner for board memos.
